introduction: Bring coal and the broken furnace valve to the Drifter captain for a ticket, then exchange that exact ticket with Decker for the Master’s helm. Hordine independently accepts sea maps for equipment or a torn treasure map for a sunken-chest key. Exchanges, current material, optional earlier history and travel are separate. New journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: Storm Port Stronghold zone226 is reached from the Surface: bay636281 south and bay636680 east lead to ocean22600, and grass636682 west leads to forest22634. All three routes have reciprocal returns. Outside room22607 now correctly places the outpost west, with the forest path east.

Decker22617 starts in forest22634. The Drifter captain22636 starts at helm22643. At glade22631, use UP on fixed rope ladder22617 to deck22640; the fixed ladder22618 at stern22642 goes DOWN to22631. These use existing portal and movement restrictions, not the ticket as a fare.

The captain needs both exact pile of coal22610 and broken valve22612 together. Coal is hidden in the locked fixed juggernaught furnace-container22609 at slave gallows22663; black iron key22611 is carried by slave master22624 at22662. The container has pickproof/locked/closed flags. Valve is hidden stock carried by ifrit22618 inside Drifter furnace22647.

ENTER the fixed Drifter furnace22604 at22641 to reach22647. The fixed return furnace22605 there ENTERs back to22641. No ordinary exits are authored in22647. Key, source visibility and current return portal need qualification; the journal grants no new access or personal kill requirement.

Offer coal and valve together for ticket22613, then offer that exact ticket to Decker for helm22621. Matching supplied ticket fits without personally helping the captain. The captain’s message says the ship can take off, but no local launch, departure, fare redemption or Decker escort controller is bound. Ticket receipt and helm exchange do not prove a travelled journey.

Hordine Scorn22626 starts on the juggernaught bridge22659. Native sea maps22622 are hidden G stock on ghost Aphantan22623, initially at multizone load room22649. That room has outward links and no identified static incoming route. Aphantan has neither SENTINEL nor STAY_ZONE and can wander out under the shared movement rules; find current legitimate stock rather than relying on a route into the load room.

Hordine exchanges exact sea maps22622 for shoes22627, ruby globe22625 and imported greaves40771. Local greaves22626 are a different prototype. The same sea maps are consumed by Oberon helmsman77218 in the Jade Mini Zones for no authored reward; choose uses or obtain another legitimate copy. Mui Pai appears in treasure lore and is not that map-hand-in recipient.

The torn treasure map77209 is a separate hidden item, held by a pirate77219 in Jade Mini Zones room77248. Burgadan38037 in Thetis initially38013 accepts it and returns the same prototype plus deep-sea spade38037. That foreign referral can be done before giving the map to Hordine; matching supplied map/spade also fits without your own referral history.

Hordine consumes torn map77209 for treasure key22633. Chest77210 is placed on Jade Mini Zones ocean floor77262. The paired silt exits77261 DOWN/77262 UP use spade38037 as their key and reset secret/closed/locked. Ordinary keyed UNLOCK has a 100 percent break roll for spade and treasure key, with destruction settlement separate. Carry legitimate replacements as needed. The silt route is a door/key mechanic; DIG rejects underwater terrain and does not use the spade keyword as its shovel/hoe/pick tool.

Opening the chest and collecting its coins, flippers, scepter or gauntlets is a later foreign access/loot route, not another recorded Stronghold story. Source GET, first recovery, source versus gift, personal kills, unlocking, reading and travel/arrival need separate admitted facts before credit.

Crew hiring at unfinished structure22648 is a separate evil-aligned owner/ship/frags-or-skills service. Its shared handler ignores SUB_MONEY failure and proceeds to change/save crew or chief; SUB_MONEY refuses while accounting is active. This accounting defect needs an isolated shared fix and transaction qualification; the journal does not claim the service is safely paid or award crew-hire credit.

The Master’s helm uses an active equipment-set procedure, not a set-completion quest. Foreign vehicle avatars can supply helm or maelstrom boots; Divine Home and Myrabolus have separate reward routes. Owning their equipment does not prove Decker’s or Hordine’s exchange. Rakshasa shop prose has no local shop file; ordinary resting/inn and other service lore remains builder qualification.

Four native exchanges are potential daily candidates. All givers remain after acceptance, but cap1 sources, hidden stock, Aphantan’s roaming, portals, key breakage, reset mode2 and active accounting’s item-reset refusal still need played availability and renewal qualification. No source, movement, pickup, reward or live ship change is added.
